title: Towards Human-Centred Explainability Benchmarks For Text Classification
reasoning: The paper is a position paper on human-centred explainability benchmarks for text classification. While it touches on topics with ethical implications like misinformation detection and user trust, its primary focus is on the technical evaluation of explanation quality (plausibility, faithfulness) and how to design benchmarks for it, not on evaluating or benchmarking specific ethical, moral, or religious content or decision-making processes of the models.
